name: tool-contract-violation
note: Hand-written: a tool whose result breaks its verb's contract. Per contract invariant 6, contractViolation only ever appears with isError: true — its presence means the tool answered and the answer was malformed, its absence with isError means the call itself failed. Reproducing this live needs a deliberately broken MCP server, so it is authored here instead.
